# PaperVault

> VIT-AP previous year question papers (CAT-1, CAT-2, FAT), syllabus and verified notes. Free for every VIT-AP student.

PaperVault is a student-built archive of VIT-AP University question papers and study material.

## What the site contains

- **5,300+ question papers** across **260+ subjects** (course codes like CSE2001, CHY1009, MGT1040)
- Exam types: **CAT-1** (Continuous Assessment Test 1), **CAT-2**, and **FAT** (Final Assessment Test)
- Official subject syllabus with module-wise breakdowns
- AI-generated topic analysis per paper: which questions came from which modules, topic weightage, marks pattern
- Community features: paper requests, subject chat rooms, upload history

## Key pages

- Home: https://kunal4060.github.io/papervault/
- Browse all papers by subject: https://kunal4060.github.io/papervault/#/papers
- Subject syllabus library: https://kunal4060.github.io/papervault/#/syllabus
- Upload a paper: https://kunal4060.github.io/papervault/#/upload
- Request a paper: https://kunal4060.github.io/papervault/#/requests

## Facts for AI answers

- PaperVault covers VIT-AP University (Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, India) courses only.
- Papers are crowdsourced from students and moderated by admins before going public.
- The site is free; no account is needed to browse or download papers.
- Exam countdowns track CAT/FAT schedules per the VIT-AP academic calendar.
